en: Poverty, disease, sorrow, captivity and misfortune are the fruits that grow on the tree of a person's own wrongdoing.
Wealth can be gained again, a friend again, a wife again, land again; all these can be had again, but not this human body.
When many beings join together they defeat the enemy; even blades of grass, woven together, keep out the rain from a pouring cloud.

first: जलै तैलं खले गुह्यं पात्रे दानं मनागपि ।
en: Oil on water, a secret told to a wicked person, a gift to a worthy person however small, and knowledge given to a wise person all spread out by their own nature.

first: धर्माख्याने श्मशाने च रोगिणां या मतिर्भवेत् ।
en: If the mind we have while hearing a religious talk, at a cremation ground, or during sickness stayed with us always, who would not be set free?
If the good sense that comes after regret came before the act, who would not do well in life?

first: दाने तपसि शौर्यं वा विज्ञाने विनये नये ।
en: Do not be proud of your giving, penance, courage, knowledge, modesty or good judgement; the earth holds many such jewels.

first: दरस्थोऽपि न दूरशो यो यस्य मनसि स्थितः ।
en: One who lives in someone's mind is not far away even when far; one who is not in someone's heart is far away even when near.
Always speak pleasantly to the one you want something from; the hunter sings sweetly when he goes to kill the deer.
Being too close to a king, fire, a teacher or women leads to ruin, and staying too far brings no benefit; deal with them from a middle distance.

first: अग्निरापः स्त्रियो मूर्खाः सर्पो राजकुलानि च ।
en: Fire, water, women, fools, snakes and royal families must always be handled with care, for these six can take life in an instant.

first: स जीवति गुणा यस्य यस्य धर्मः स जीवति ।
en: He truly lives who has good qualities and righteousness; the life of one without good qualities and righteousness is useless.
If you wish to win over the world by one single act, keep your tongue, like a wandering cow, from grazing in front of the fifteen mouths of the senses.
One who knows how to speak words that suit the occasion, show kindness that suits his position, and show anger that matches his strength is wise.

first: एक एव पदार्थस्तु त्रिधा भवति वीक्षितः ।
en: One and the same thing is seen in three ways: a woman's body is a corpse to a yogi, a lovely woman to a lustful man, and a piece of meat to dogs.
A wise person does not reveal a well-made medicine, his own good deeds, the faults of his home, his love-making, bad food he has eaten, or bad things he has heard.
Cuckoos pass their days in silence until the time comes for their song, which brings joy to everyone.

first: धर्मं धनं च धान्यं च गुरोर्वचनमौषधम् ।
en: Righteousness, wealth, grain, the teacher's words and medicine should be received well and used properly; otherwise one does not live well.
Leave the company of the wicked, seek the company of the good, do good deeds day and night, and always keep in mind what lasts and what passes away.
